inputs.text: New York City’s sanctuary policies are putting ideology ahead of the basic duty to protect the public. A gang member with an illegal immigration status was released despite the danger he posed, and ICE had to step in and make the arrest. When local officials obstruct cooperation with federal authorities, ordinary citizens are left to bear the risk. Public safety and equal enforcement of the law should come before political posturing or special treatment for people with criminal records.
